_说明: 特别通道：按主题挑出来单独展览的项目。网页 3D 入口的主流转盘里有一扇对应的「门」，点进去是一条通道，卡片沿着通道往里排；README 里也有对应的一节。项目必须已经收录在 projects.json 里。why 写这个项目为什么放进这条通道（比项目说明更具体），why_en 是英文版。

channels.name: three.js 出片通道
channels.look: 用 three.js 做视频的精选：把场景渲染成 MP4 的管线，让 AI 编程助手写 three.js 出片的技能和作品，还有镜头里常用的特效。
channels.look_en: Hand-picked projects for making videos with three.js: pipelines that render scenes to MP4, coding-agent skills and films built on three.js, and the effects you'll reach for in your shots.

groups.name: 出片管线
groups.desc: 把 three.js 场景变成视频

items.why: 官方的 @remotion/three 包把 three.js 和 React Three Fiber 场景放进 React 视频，逐帧渲染成 MP4。
items.why_en: Its official @remotion/three package puts three.js and React Three Fiber scenes into React videos and renders them frame by frame to MP4.

items.why: 用 React 组件写 three.js 场景，是和 Remotion 搭配做 3D 视频最常见的写法。
items.why_en: Write three.js scenes as React components; the most common way to make 3D videos together with Remotion.

items.why: 可视化时间轴：在界面里给 three.js 的镜头和物体拖关键帧，适合精确运镜。
items.why_en: A visual timeline: keyframe three.js cameras and objects in an editor, good for precise camera moves.

items.why: three.js 作者写的时间轴编辑器，按时间编排镜头和特效，做成网页 demo 短片。
items.why_en: A timeline editor by the author of three.js for sequencing shots and effects into web demos.

items.why: 这一切的底座：场景、材质、灯光、粒子和后期处理都在这里。
items.why_en: The foundation: scenes, materials, lights, particles and post-processing.

groups.name: AI 写 three.js 出片
groups.desc: 让 AI 编程助手写 three.js 代码出片的技能和作品
groups.desc_en: Skills and films where coding agents write the three.js code

items.why: 一分钟的竖屏动画故事：2D 角色走进彩色 3D 小镇，three.js 加 Remotion 渲染。
items.why_en: One-minute vertical story shorts: 2D characters in a colourful 3D town, rendered with three.js inside Remotion.

items.why: 六个做短视频动画的技能，其中有 three.js 3D 卡通讲解和爆炸拆解图。
items.why_en: Six short-video animation skills, including three.js 3D cartoon explainers and exploded views.

items.why: 让 AI 编程助手搭 three.js 微缩场景，小人带关节动画，默认是像素抖动风。
items.why_en: Coding agents build three.js dioramas with jointed little characters, in a dithered pixel look by default.

items.why: 卡点展示片技能：HTML、Canvas 和 three.js 逐帧渲染成片。
items.why_en: A beat-synced showcase video skill that renders HTML, Canvas and three.js frame by frame.

items.why: 先给三个方案和预览再逐帧渲染，three.js 是它常用的 3D 引擎之一。
items.why_en: Offers three directions with previews before rendering frame by frame; three.js is one of the 3D engines it uses.

items.why: 照着参考图用纯代码重建 three.js 模型，可以给 3D 短片做道具和角色。
items.why_en: Rebuilds three.js models from a reference image in pure code, handy for props and characters in 3D shorts.

items.why: Claude 用 three.js 纯代码搭出的古希腊城邦，零素材，可以当 3D 场景参考。
items.why_en: An ancient Greek city built by Claude entirely in three.js code with no assets; a good reference for 3D scenes.

groups.name: 镜头里的特效
groups.desc: three.js 出片时常加的后期、粒子、光照和场景
groups.desc_en: Post-processing, particles, lighting and scenes for three.js shots

items.why: 辉光、色差、景深、故障，three.js 出片最常用的后期库。
items.why_en: Bloom, chromatic aberration, depth of field and glitch: the go-to post-processing library for three.js videos.

items.why: 火焰、爆炸、魔法粒子，给镜头加 VFX。
items.why_en: Fire, explosions and magic particles: VFX for your shots.

items.why: GPU 路径追踪，让画面有真实的光照、反射和景深，适合慢慢渲染成片。
items.why_en: GPU path tracing for realistic light, reflections and depth of field, good for offline-quality renders.

items.why: 在 three.js 里驱动 VRM 虚拟形象，做二次元 MV。
items.why_en: Drive VRM avatars in three.js for anime-style music videos.

items.why: 用 three.js 着色语言 TSL 写的黑洞，WebGPU 和 WebGL 都能跑，适合宇宙镜头。
items.why_en: A black hole written in three.js's TSL shading language that runs on WebGPU or WebGL, made for space shots.

items.why: GPU 实时计算的 FFT 海洋，three.js 加 WebGPU，适合海面镜头。
items.why_en: A real-time GPU FFT ocean in three.js with WebGPU, made for sea shots.
